_about: Ionity lab template - the one place the lab network is defined. No secrets here (WiFi password lives only in git-ignored secrets.h). Policy 986 AED.

household.rule: Internet only. No lab boards, no lab DNS, no lab services on this network.

lab.wifi_note: wifi_ssid is what the boards join. ESP32-S3 / Pico 2 W radios are 2.4 GHz only, so the lab keeps one low-power 2.4 GHz network for them.
lab.rule: All boards, the Pi 5 and lab services live here. Isolated from the household.
